probes.name: DEPENDING_ON_uppercase
probes.source:
WHEN choose <flag> into <total>
  GIVEN flag is boolean
  AND total is integer
  DEPENDING ON flag
    WHEN the value is true
      set total to 1
    WHEN the value is false
      set total to 2
SCENARIO dispatch
GIVEN total is 0
WHEN choose true into total
THEN total == 1
